elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires Licensor to maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than US$2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause affirmatively requires Licensor to maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than US$5,000,000 covering its processing of Licensee data; this supplies the required coverage rather than relying on the condition being absent.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance upon Customer's request.
elements.evidence: Licensor must provide certificates of insurance evidencing the required coverage upon Licensee's request.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required US$2,000,000 professional liability limit exceeds the fallback US$1,000,000 limit.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires US$5,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance covering Licensor's processing of Licensee data, exceeding the fallback US$2,000,000 limit.

result.reason: The operative insurance covenant satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the reduced fallback limits, with Licensor and Licensee serving as the vendor and customer roles. It is not minimal because it additionally requires all coverage for one year after termination and extends cyber coverage to Confidential Information, neither of which is required by the stated positions. The unchanged representation-by-counsel provision remains effective, and no contradiction is introduced.
